title: download the source code for 'bash' and turn it into an example_repo
description: try https://github.com/bminor/bash/tree/master, get it building and get 'make test' working. Then copy to example_repos/bash/before as raw source. Then 'boil --hard make test' on it and get that passing, hopefully with some deleted files as a result. When you get a working result, copy that to example_repos/bash/after and commit. This will be a new example we can test boiler with\! Please add bd tasks for this epic before you begin work
